newsitem.title: USA: FED SEEN ADDING RESERVES VIA 3-DAY SYSTEM RPS.
newsitem.headline: FED SEEN ADDING RESERVES VIA 3-DAY SYSTEM RPS.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was expected to add reserves into the banking system on Monday through a round of three-day fixed system repurchase agreements.
The Fed, analysts project, faces around a $4.5 billion a day add need for the remaining three days of the maintenance period.
Thursday, the Fed added $3.8 billion in reserves, but those repos come off the books this session and need to be replaced, analysts said. The Fed stayed out of the open market on Friday.
Federal funds were trading at the 5-1/2 percent target rate in early trading.
